jei.chiseled_enchanting_table.tooltip.co: Material cost may be one of several accepted items
Material cost as resolved by the server for you
jei.chiseled_enchanting_table.tooltip.bo: The enchanted book must be placed in a nearby chiseled bookshelf
jei.chiseled_enchanting_table.info.stati: The chiseled enchanting table applies an enchantment from a nearby chiseled bookshelf. Place enchanted books inside chiseled bookshelves within range, then pick an option in the table's list.
jei.chiseled_enchanting_table.info.books: Chiseled bookshelves within range of the table supply the enchantments you can apply. Each book in a shelf slot unlocks its enchantment.
jei.chiseled_enchanting_table.info.book: Enchanted books unlock their enchantment while stored in a nearby chiseled bookshelf. Applying an enchantment from a book in the cost slot consumes the book.
